subject: PlatinumAI renewal — QBR slotting & term options
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@platinumai.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff: QBR slotting & term options

Alex —

Thanks again for the call last week. We'd like to kick off the renewal and expansion planning for PlatinumAI so the team can lock in capacity for your next fiscal year and get the QBR on calendars. High-level items we want to cover in the first session:

- Confirm target renewal date and desired term length (12 vs 24 months)
- Capacity uplift scenarios (+1.5x, +2x) and pricing delta
- Operational readiness: onboarding staff, runbook, rollback/fallback policies
- Legal/procurement next steps and timeline for SOW/signature

Proposed 60-minute QBR blocks (all PDT):
- Wed Jun 19, 2029 — 10:00–11:00
- Thu Jun 20, 2029 — 14:00–15:00
- Mon Jun 24, 2029 — 09:00–10:00

Please confirm which slot works best and who from your side should join (exec+procurement+engineering recommended). I've attached a short spreadsheet with three term/capacity scenarios and a draft SOW for legal to review.

Next steps if you confirm a slot:
- Kimberly will produce a formal pricing quote tied to the chosen scenario
- Stephanie will draft an onboarding staffing plan and milestone dates
- Connor will prepare a technical checklist and pre-read for the QBR

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Marcus
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Platinum_Renewal_Term_Scenarios.xlsx (spreadsheet); SOW_v2-draft.pdf (PDF)

From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@platinumai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tariq Hasan <tariq.hasan@platinumai.com>, PlatinumAI Legal <legal@platinumai.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2029 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: QBR slotting & term options

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the clear agenda.

We're definitely planning for an uplift (targeting ~2x peak throughput) and prefer a 24-month term if pricing is favorable. For attendees, please include procurement (Tariq) and our in-house counsel (legal@platinumai.com).

Of the three slots, Thu Jun 20 14:00–15:00 PDT looks best for our execs. The 19th conflicts with a board prep day.

Two asks before we lock:
1) Can you provide a ballpark for committed-discount tiers for +2x vs +1.5x? We need guidance for our procurement team.
2) Legal will want to review the SOW — can you confirm if the attached SOW in this thread is the latest draft (we had an earlier redline in March)?

If you want, Tariq can join a short procurement-only sync before the QBR (15–20m) to clarify PO timelines.

—Alex
Head of Platform
PlatinumAI

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@platinumai.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jun 2029 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: QBR slotting & term options

Alex — great, Jun 20 at 14:00 PDT is tentatively booked on our side. Thanks for confirming attendees (Tariq + Legal).

Quick answers and owners:

- SOW status: The SOW attached is v2 — it includes the March legal redlines plus minor operational clarifications. I re-attached SOW_v2-draft.pdf for convenience. If Legal needs a tracked/redline view we can provide a PDF with changes highlighted.

- Pricing/discounts: Kimberly will own formal pricing. High-level guidance: committed 24-month terms with a 2x uplift generally qualify for a step discount (we offer both committed % discounts and unit-price staircases depending on profile). Kimberly, can you please draft two concrete price rows for the QBR: A) 24-month, 2x commit; B) 24-month, 1.5x commit. Please include expected token/unit economics and any one-time onboarding credits.

- Procurement sync: Tariq — happy to do a 20-minute call if helpful. Connor and I can join.

Owners and immediate asks:
- Kimberly Park: pricing quote + short slide (1 page) with the two scenarios — due Jun 14 EOD
- Stephanie Nguyen: onboarding staffing plan + milestone dates for a Jul/Aug kickoff — due Jun 14 EOD
- Connor O'Brien: technical pre-read (capacity runbook, fallback policies) — due Jun 18 EOD

Alex — once Kimberly shares the pricing slide, we'll include it in the QBR pre-read. If Jun 20 is still good on your side I'll switch the invite to a confirmed QBR.

Thanks,
Marcus

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2029 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing slides (preliminary) for PLAT-459 — delivery

Team —

Attached are two preliminary price rows and assumptions for PLAT-459 (see "Platinum_Pricing_OnePager" sheet in the attached workbook). Highlights:

- Option A: 24-month term, 2.0x committed capacity — committed discount: 18% off hosted unit rates, onboarding credit: $25k one-time
- Option B: 24-month term, 1.5x committed capacity — committed discount: 12% off hosted unit rates, onboarding credit: $10k one-time

Assumptions called out in the sheet: token mix, expected sequence lengths, estimated steady-state concurrency. If engineering sees materially different load shapes we'll adjust the unit economics.

Next: Marcus, please confirm we can include these rows in the QBR pre-read. I can produce a single-slide summary and a one-line procurement note on invoicing cadence by EOD.

Kimberly
Director, Pricing & Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@platinumai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tariq Hasan <tariq.hasan@platinumai.com>, PlatinumAI Legal <legal@platinumai.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2029 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: QBR slotting & term options

Marcus / team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the pricing options. We reviewed with Tariq and legal; Option A (24-month, 2.0x commit) is our preferred path pending the final SOW redlines. Jun 20 14:00–15:00 PDT works for us — please send the calendar invite.

Legal has requested a tracked-change copy of SOW_v2 and will circulate comments by Mon Jun 17. Also, please send the QBR pre-read (pricing slide + technical checklist) by Mon Jun 17 COB so our execs can review ahead of the call.

DocSign link for signature to follow in parallel (we'll need to confirm PO timing in the procurement sync).

See you on the 20th.

—Alex
